heroHeadline: South Korea Demands Japanese Apology as Condition for Military Cooperation
heroSubtitle: Seoul told Tokyo that a formal apology over wartime history is a prerequisite before advancing bilateral military cooperation, complicating efforts to deepen security ties amid shared concerns about North Korea.
